topic: Training of the final model (report section 5.1 and 5.2)
source: summary of the training record, the checkpoint manifest and the offline prefix validation; raw files and weights are not in Git

policy.startingPoint: the HSR model already fine-tuned from it (public model)

prefixNoise.kind: one Gaussian offset per sample and real axis over the committed goals, normalized units

settings.trainable: action expert and the state, action and time projections; the SmolVLM2 vision and language model stay frozen

wallTime: about 2 h on one GPU, estimated from 1.2 updates/s observed in a run with the same recipe and another seed
validationLossNote: flow matching loss on 16 validation samples with random noise and time, so it is noisy; the final checkpoint (8000) was used without selecting by loss

offlinePrefixError.metric: normalized mean absolute error of the goals after the committed prefix, validation data, by number of committed goals
offlinePrefixError.note: lower offline error did not predict continuous success; see mug-phase2-candidates-2026-10-28.json
